pa.name: pa
pa.description: position angle from north to east

mag.name: mag

jdisk.name: jdisk

jbulge.description: specific angular momentum of the bulge

zgas_disk.name: zgas_disk
zgas_disk.description: metallicity of the gas in the disk

zgas_bulge.name: zgas_bulge
zgas_bulge.description: metallicity of the gas in the bulge

sfr_disk.name: sfr_disk
sfr_disk.description: star formation rate in the disk
